landing.headline: Where artists and customers meet, chat, and commission art
landing.subtitle: Share your work, grow your audience, talk to customers directly, and get paid your way — PromptPay, PayPal, or bank transfer. You keep 100%.
landing.feature1Body: Post your work to a feed, get likes and comments, and build a following.
landing.feature2Body: Message artists and customers in realtime — discuss ideas before committing.
landing.feature3Body: Show your PromptPay QR, PayPal link, or bank details right on your profile.

auth.checkEmailBody: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Click it to finish creating your account.

onboarding.title: Set up your profile
onboarding.subtitle: Choose how others will see you.
onboarding.usernameHint: 3–30 characters: letters, numbers and underscore. This becomes your profile link.
onboarding.usernameInvalid: Usernames can only use letters, numbers and underscore (3–30 characters).
onboarding.usernameTaken: That username is already taken — try another one.
onboarding.artistToggleHint: Unlocks commission status, payment methods and your artist profile.

payments.title: Payment methods
payments.subtitle: Pay this artist directly using any method below.
payments.disclaimer: Payments go directly to the artist. Always confirm the details in chat before paying, and keep your payment slip.

feed.emptyFollowing: Nothing here yet — follow some artists to fill your feed.

post.deleteConfirm: Delete this post? This cannot be undone.

settings.title: Settings
settings.artistModeHint: Show commission status and payment methods on your profile.
settings.termsPlaceholder: Revisions included, refund policy, usage rights, deadlines…
settings.paymentsHint: These are shown on your profile so customers can pay you directly. Untick "visible" to hide one without deleting it.
settings.promptpayNeedsSomething: Add a PromptPay ID or upload a QR image.
settings.paypalNeedsUrl: Enter a full link starting with https:// (e.g. https://paypal.me/yourname).
settings.otherNeedsInstructions: Describe how customers should pay you.
settings.noMethods: No payment methods yet — add your PromptPay QR so customers can pay you.
settings.qrHint: Tip: save your QR from your banking app and upload it here. It is shown full quality so it stays scannable.
